SIDDHARTH RAO

Aspiring App Developer

+91 98123 45611 | siddharth.rao2024@gmail.com |
linkedin.com/in/siddharthrao-dev | github.com/siddharthrao-dev | Pune,
Maharashtra

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Motivated B.Tech Computer Science student passionate about mobile
application development. Experienced in building cross-platform apps
using Flutter and React Native with clean, maintainable architecture.
Seeking an App Developer Internship to build user-centric mobile
products.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology — Information Technology | 2023 – 2027 (Expected)

D.Y. Patil College of Engineering, Pune CGPA: 8.4 / 10.0

Relevant Coursework: Mobile Application Development, Android
Programming, UI/UX Design, DBMS, Cloud Basics

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: Dart, Kotlin, JavaScript, Python

Frameworks: Flutter, React Native, Android SDK

Backend & Tools: Firebase, REST APIs, SQLite, Git, GitHub

Platforms: Android Studio, Xcode (basic), Play Console, Postman

EXPERIENCE

Mobile App Development Intern — Synapse Analytics Pvt. Ltd., Pune | June
2024 – July 2024

- Developed UI screens and state management logic for a Flutter-based
internal field-reporting app.

- Integrated Firebase Authentication and Firestore, reducing backend
setup time by 50%.

- Fixed 25+ UI/performance bugs, improving app crash-free rate to 98%.

PROJECTS

Campus Event Management App | Flutter, Firebase Jan 2024 – Mar 2024

- Built a cross-platform app for event discovery, RSVP, and push
notifications.

- Used Firestore for real-time updates across 500+ simulated users.

- Published a working APK with 4.5+ rating in internal testing.

Personal Finance Tracker App | Flutter, SQLite, Provider Sep 2023 – Nov
2023

- Built an offline-first expense tracker with category-wise analytics
and charts.

- Implemented local notifications for budget alerts.

Fitness Tracking App | React Native, Firebase Jul 2023 – Aug 2023

- Built a step-counter and workout-logging app using device sensors.

- Synced data across devices using Firebase Realtime Database.

CERTIFICATIONS

Meta Android Developer Professional Certificate — Coursera Completed:
Aug 2023

Mobile Application Development, Score: 86/100 — NPTEL (IIT Madras)
Completed: Nov 2023

Programming Foundations with JavaScript, HTML and CSS — IBM / Coursera
Completed: May 2023

ACHIEVEMENTS & AWARDS

- Selected among 80 students college-wide for the Smart India
Hackathon (SIH 2024) internal round.

- Received the Academic Excellence Award for Semester 2 with the
highest GPA (9.3) in the CSE department cohort of 120 students.

- Active contributor to two college-wide technical fests, coordinating
logistics and technical sessions for 150+ participants.

EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES

- Core Member, Technical Club, VIT Pune — organised hands-on workshops
for 150+ students (2023–Present).

- Technical Blogger — published articles on Medium covering tools and
best practices relevant to the field; collectively read 4,000+
times.

- Volunteer Mentor, CodeForGood (NGO Initiative) — guided 15 high
school students through technology fundamentals over an 8-week
programme.
